correctness.rationale: The Chebyshev tangent support proof at C=cos(pi/(2m)) yields a nonnegative singleton extremizer with exactly two contact points pi±pi/(2m). The first and m harmonics vanish appropriately at contacts to force a<=sec(alpha). At these points cos(n theta)=(-1)^n cos(n alpha), zero iff n an odd multiple of m. For nonzero contact value the perturbation R=cos(theta)+2C/q cos(n theta) equals C>0 at BOTH zeros; compactness makes P_m+epsilon R positive for sufficiently small epsilon>0. Checked m>=3 and full-circle quantifiers; grid checks not used as proof.
